title: XGuard Web Extractor input
description: Extract clean Markdown, text, metadata, and links from public web pages.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: One or more public HTTP/HTTPS URLs to crawl.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on fetched pages per run.

sameDomain.title: Stay on the same domain
sameDomain.description: Follow discovered links only on the same domain as each start URL.

followLinks.title: Follow links
followLinks.description: Discover and crawl linked pages after each start URL.

includeLinks.title: Include links in output
includeLinks.description: Include up to 200 normalized links from every extracted page.

maxContentChars.title: Maximum content characters per page
maxContentChars.description: Maximum Markdown/text characters stored per page to control run cost.
